svg.title: Chi square, Student t and F densities
svg.desc: Three degrees of freedom per family; t also compared to standard normal. All densities computed from gamma-function formulas.

g.text: Independent standard normals generate the square sums and ratios.
All curves are exact densities; probability is area. Supports extend beyond each finite plot.
t with df=1 is Cauchy: symmetry does not make its mean exist.
